topics.name: Candidate Review Tree
topics.purpose: Define the candidate/review tree as a complete parallel canonical source tree used for migration, reconciliation and validation before replacing the accepted canonical tree.

semantics.identity_rule: Candidate tree/snapshot has an explicit review identity.
semantics.source_rule: Candidate tree is built from explicit source artifacts/patches/reconciliation outcomes.
semantics.separation_rule: Candidate tree is not the accepted canonical source until explicit acceptance.
semantics.completeness_rule: Candidate must be structurally complete enough to run all mandatory repository validations.
semantics.mutation_rule: Source accepted tree is not modified in place while building/reviewing candidate.
semantics.manifest_rule: Candidate carries source/migration/patch provenance sufficient to reproduce it.
semantics.runtime_rule: Candidate existence does not automatically activate runtime configuration.

invariants.rule: Candidate canonical trees become accepted/locked only through explicit reproducible validation and clean replacement; review state, acceptance state and runtime activation remain distinct.

hard_gates.condition: candidate tree treated as accepted automatically
accepted source mutated in-place during review
candidate validation performed on incomplete/partial tree without declared partial profile

references.purpose: Candidate is assembled from explicit source artifacts.
